logₐ x is the inverse of aˣ: logₐ x = y ⟺ aʸ = x. Natural log: ln x = logₑ x.
log(xy) = log x + log y; log(x/y) = log x − log y; log(xⁿ) = n log x. Same base throughout.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Exponentials & Logarithms — a core area of A-Level Maths.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Exponentials & Logarithms brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Exponentials & Logarithms.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between area and perimeter?
options: Area is half the perimeter for any shape.
Perimeter is the total distance around the outside; area is the amount of surface inside (measured in square units).
x^(1/2) means 1 divided by x squared.
Area and perimeter are different names for the same measurement.

mcqs.q: On a probability tree, how do you find the probability of a sequence of outcomes along one path?
options: Multiply the probabilities along that path.
Add the probabilities along the path.
Take the average of the probabilities on the branches.
